title: Part 1: The Impossible Immortals of Manhattan

series.summary: At the Daily Days newspaper in Manhattan, Vice President Gustav and assistant Carol investigate the violent gang war of 1930, only to discover records proving the mobsters were aboard the alchemist ship Advena Avis in 1711.

cuts.voiceover_text: Every murder investigation needs a starting point, but in 1930 Manhattan, the timeline makes no sense. Inside the Daily Days newspaper headquarters, Vice President Gustav St. Germain stands beside the high window, watching the rain clear over the gray skyline. His assistant Carol waits by his desk, clutching her notebook. She wants to publish a story on the gang war that erupted that November. But Gustav stops her cold. He demands to know why people accept easy answers without question. Carol hesitates, caught off guard. She believes the facts speak for themselves. Gustav warns her that raw information is worthless until someone understands the hidden connections beneath it.

Carol tries to salvage her theory by naming a clear hero. She points to young mobster Firo Prochainezo, insisting the entire conflict began with his sudden rise inside the Martillo family. Gustav immediately dismantles the idea. If Firo is the protagonist, then what about the butchered bodies discovered in the garden? What about the rival syndicates pulling the strings from the shadows? Carol falters as the contradiction hits her. Her neat explanation is falling apart. Gustav reminds her that an investigator cannot simply pick a favorite face and ignore the collateral damage left in their wake. The real mastermind behind the bloodshed is someone far more dangerous.

Determined to prove her point, Carol heads deep into the massive archive vaults of the Daily Days. She climbs past towering wooden shelves and pulls down heavy dossiers from late 1930. Yellowed news clippings detail a brutal turf war tearing New York apart. Crime bosses are vanishing overnight, rival hitmen are ambushed in back alleys, and innocent bystanders are getting gunned down in broad daylight. Carol spreads the police reports across the reading table, convinced the chaos originated right here in the city. Her confidence returns as she highlights the bloody dates. Gustav watches her quietly from the aisle. He knows she is searching the wrong century entirely.

Gustav steps forward and unlocks a restricted archive drawer from two centuries earlier. He pulls out an ancient maritime ledger detailing the voyage of the alchemist ship Advena Avis in 1711. Carol assumes it is an eccentric joke, but her confidence evaporates instantly. The exact same mobsters shooting up Manhattan in 1930 are listed on the passenger manifest from over two hundred years ago. They have not aged a single day. Gustav confirms the horrifying reality: the killers roaming New York cannot die. Carol stares in frozen terror at the impossible records before her. Who created these immortals, and what brought their centuries-old curse to the streets of Manhattan?
